payload.title: File:Ahshislesaurus Skeletal Main.png
payload.description_html:
Skeletal reconstruction of Ahshislesaurus wimani, a large kritosaurin hadrosaur from the lower part of the Late Cretaceous Hunter Wash Member of the Kirtland Formation of New Mexico. Based on the holotype USNM PV-8629, a partial skull with some neck vertebrae, and referred specimen NMMNH P-66929, a partial jaw bone. Unknown material filled in using other tentatively referred specimens NMMNH P-25057, 32928, 32885, 102629, and NMMNH P-RMS 2013-7, as well as Naashoibitosaurus, Gryposaurus, Kritosaurus, Edmontosaurus, and Corythosaurus. Total length through the centra is approximately 10.0 m for the holotype and 11.5 m for the referred dentary. 
References: Dalman et. al., 2025, Hunt et. al., 1993, Mallon et. al., 2022, and Bertozzo et. al., 2017.
